name: Heartburn
overview: Heartburn is a health topic that clinicians and patients frequently discuss during care planning in India and worldwide. Key considerations include burning sensation felt behind the breastbone. This summary is educational and should be paired with professional medical evaluation.
possibleCauses: From a clinical perspective, heartburn is a burning sensation felt behind the breastbone.
In routine practice, it is a symptom that is commonly linked to acid reflux and is often triggered by food.
In routine practice, lying down, bending, lifting, and performing certain exercises can exacerbate heartburn.
In routine practice, causes include acid reflux, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), damage to the esophageal lining, bile acid, mechanical stimulation to the esophagus...
In routine practice, heartburn affects 25% of the population at least once a month.
